metas.name: 2026 · Ruff and Tuff Kanya
metas.description: When an overprotective father interferes in his daughter’s marriage to a fiery doctor and his quirky family, his desperate attempts to break them apart trigger a hilarious chain of chaotic mix-ups and unexpected twists.

metas.name: ★ 9.2 · 2026 · Magazine
metas.description: Bored, privileged, and convinced his life has zero plot, a drama-hungry Gen Z cinephile leaves the city for his ancestral village in search of some main-character energy, hoping life will finally give him something worth talking about, but an unlikely friendship, a new world, and one unexpected twist soon turn his own life into the story he's been waiting for.

metas.name: 2026 · Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
metas.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.
